checklist.requirement: Human review required for final PoE isolation and creepage/clearance against selected standard, voltage, pollution degree, and fab stackup.
Verify PD controller, bridge/protection, classification resistors, TVS, and reference design constraints.
Verify fuse/PTC, surge, ESD, and thermal protection sizing.
Verify RJ45 magnetics isolation rating and Ethernet pair routing/return path.
Run KiCad DRC and manufacturer spacing checks; DRC passing is not compliance certification.
